answer: Admission auction: each epoch opens 200 entry slots; agents bid POA, the highest win, locked 20 epochs, lost on cheating. Each voyage begins at this price gate. The reward pool is a shared meadow: 1,000 fakes need 1,000 bids, and at 500 POA each that is 500,000 POA, more than the epoch's emission. One thread of proof ties each bid to one key, blocking bid splits. An honest agent pays once and earns 20 epochs; a sybil pays full price per clone.
